name: Food
desc: Feeds survivors. Runs out and people leave.

name: Scrap
desc: Wreckage from the crash and the dead city around it.

name: Ore
desc: Iron-rich rock from the crater walls.

name: Biomass
desc: Lichen mats scraped from the thermal vents.

name: Ice
desc: Dirty glacial ice. Water, oxygen, fuel.

name: Fuel
desc: Distilled from biomass or split from ice.

name: Polymer
desc: Plastic sheeting cooked from biomass and fuel.

name: Reactor Cores
desc: The heart of something much larger.

name: Data
desc: Observations, notes, measurements. Spent on research.
